ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description: Completely overhauls RimWorld's Work tab with drag-and-drop, skill overlays, automation rules, and visual customization. Core Features: • Drag & Drop Reordering - Click and drag columns and pawn rows to rearrange your work tab layout. Changes persist between saves. • Skill Level Overlay - Hold SHIFT to see skill levels instead of priorities. Color-coded (red→green) with "best pawn" highlighting. • Visual Rule Builder - NEW! Intuitive 3-column interface for creating auto-assignment rules. Drag-and-drop to duplicate rules across work types and priorities. • Auto-Assignment Rulesets - Create smart rules to automatically assign work priorities based on passions, skills, traits, xenotypes, gender, pregnancy, and more. • Workload Presets - Save and load entire priority configurations as named presets. Switch between different colony setups instantly. • Visual Dividers - Organize pawns into collapsible sections with custom labels, colors, and fonts. • Pawn Highlights - Color-code pawn rows for easy identification. Set custom background colors per pawn. • Advanced Highlighting - Highlight selected pawns, hovered rows/columns, and similar work types. Fully customizable colors and opacity. • Multiplayer Support - Sync workload presets and column reordering across players (row reordering is local-only). Rule-Based Automation: Build complex assignment logic with 25+ parameters: - Skill/passion thresholds (min/max) - Trait and xenotype requirements - Gender and pregnancy filters - "Highest skill", "top X skills", "Nth best" logic - Work type limits per pawn - Priority protection/overwrite rules - Random assignment for ties Includes 5 default rulesets: Vanilla Starting Pawn, Vanilla New Pawn, BWT Default (passion-based), Best Pawn to 1, and Reset All. Quality of Life: - Angled column headers save space and look great - Show colonist/bed counts at bottom - Disable left-click closing if needed - Show only insertion lines for cleaner drag preview - Right-click pawn name for quick actions (set color, rename, add divider) Requirements: - Harmony (required) Compatibility: - Designed to work with most work-type mods - Patches are postfix/transpiler-based for maximum compatibility - May conflict with other work-tab overhaul mods (test before adding) Performance: - Optimized for large colonies (50+ pawns) - Minimal overhead when idle - Efficient caching prevents frame drops Credits: - Colour picker by Karel Kroeze (MIT License) - Harmony team for patch framework Questions? See the Steam Workshop page or GitHub repository for detailed documentation and tutorials.
